    # use pixels with lum < 80 and y > 350

import workcell
from PIL import Image

def bore_centroid(path):
    im = Image.open(path)
    w,h = im.size
    pts = []
    # search lower half for dark-ish circular blob not part of huge dark region
    # use pixels with lum < 80 and y > 350
    for y in range(350, h):
        for x in range(w):
            r,g,b = im.getpixel((x,y))
            v = (r+g+b)/3
            if v < 80:
                pts.append((x,y))
    if not pts:
        return None
    # filter to largest cluster via simple bounding if multiple
    xs = [p[0] for p in pts]; ys = [p[1] for p in pts]
    cx, cy = sum(xs)/len(xs), sum(ys)/len(ys)
    # keep points near centroid (within 40 px) to reject gripper if it extends
    pts2 = [(x,y) for x,y in pts if (x-cx)**2+(y-cy)**2 < 40**2]
    if not pts2:
        pts2 = pts
    xs = [p[0] for p in pts2]; ys = [p[1] for p in pts2]
    return sum(xs)/len(xs), sum(ys)/len(ys), len(pts2), (min(xs),min(ys),max(xs),max(ys))

base_x, base_y, z = 391.64, 283.66, 80.0
moves = [
    ("origin", base_x, base_y, z),
    ("+x5", base_x+5, base_y, z),
    ("+y5", base_x, base_y+5, z),
    ("+z20", base_x, base_y, z+20),
]
for name, x, y, z_ in moves:
    r = workcell.robot("move", f"{x:.3f}", f"{y:.3f}", f"{z_:.3f}")
    print("MOVE", name, r.text)
    r = workcell.robot("camera", "wrist")
    print("CAM", r.text)
    path = r.text.split()[-1]
    print("CENT", name, bore_centroid(path))
print(workcell.robot("status").text)
